basics.name: Boming Xia
basics.label: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
basics.summary: Postdoctoral researcher at the Responsible AI Research Centre, Australian Institute for Machine Learning (AIML), University of Adelaide. My work operationalises safe and responsible AI through system-level software engineering, with a focus on the evaluation of LLMs and agents, uncertainty propagation in LLM-based systems, AI risk assessment, and software/AI supply-chain security.

location.address: Australian Institute for Machine Learning, Lot Fourteen, North Terrace

work.name: Responsible AI Research Centre, Australian Institute for Machine Learning, University of Adelaide
work.summary: Research on evaluation-driven design and uncertainty propagation in LLM-based systems; AgentOps architectures for runtime safety and risk governance; and uncertainty-aware evaluation of LLMs and agents. Contribute to cross-institutional grants in responsible AI and AI education, and supervise honours and postgraduate students.

work.name: CSIRO's Data61
work.summary: Applied research on responsible AI systems, including software/AI supply-chain assurance (SBOM/AIBOM) and governance frameworks. Designed and ran empirical studies (systematic reviews, interviews, surveys, repository analyses) with industry and public-sector stakeholders.

courses: Thesis: Operationalising Safe and Responsible AI: A System-Level Perspective
